evidence.quote: You must make an appointment with the International Students Office as soon as possible to submit the documents needed to enrol in our courses (declaration of value, foreign qualification, certificate of comparability and other documents).

notes: No duration or tuition information was found in the provided pages. The application channel is a direct online enrolment application on the university portal, as described for students with a foreign diploma who have taken the TOLC-E ENGLISH.

evidence.quote: An English language level of B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference is also required, proven by possession of one of the certifications approved by the CCSA

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission et les éventuelles exigences supplémentaires (OFA) pour les étudiants titulaires d'un diplôme étranger.
note.en: Check the admission conditions and any additional educational requirements (OFAs) for students with a foreign diploma.
